prompt.text:
Implement a parser for a compact tagged-text format in `solution.rs` using only the Rust standard library.

Expose this API:

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum FieldError {
    EmptyName,
    Malformed,
    Duplicate,
}

pub fn read_tagged_field(input: &str, name: &str) -> Result<Option<String>, FieldError>;
```

A field has the form `[name]text[/name]`. Names and delimiters are case-sensitive. Fields may appear consecutively with arbitrary text between them, but fields cannot be nested. Return the exact text between the delimiters, including whitespace. An empty field returns `Some(String::new())`.

Return `EmptyName` when `name` is empty. Return `Malformed` if any opening or closing delimiter in `input` is unmatched, mismatched, or nested. Validate the whole input even when the requested field appears early. Return `Duplicate` if the requested name occurs more than once. Return `Ok(None)` when the document is valid but the requested field is absent. Brackets in ordinary text are allowed unless they form a delimiter beginning with `[` followed immediately by `/` or an ASCII letter. Inputs must not be mutated.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
